descriptionByLocale.it: Il Project Manager supporta i team Retail guidando progetti interfunzionali volti a migliorare i processi, gli strumenti e la governance di pianificazione, allocazione, acquisto e pianificazione delle merci. Il ruolo garantisce che le iniziative strategiche e operative siano consegnate in tempo, entro l'ambito e in linea con gli obiettivi aziendali, contribuendo all'ottimizzazione delle vendite, all'efficienza dell'inventario e alla redditività nelle regioni EMEA e NA. Agendo come interfaccia chiave tra pianificazione e allocazione, finanza, acquisti, operazioni di vendita al dettaglio, IT e logistica, il Project Manager consente il cambiamento, la standardizzazione dei processi e il miglioramento continuo all'interno di un ambiente di vendita al dettaglio complesso e frenetico. Gestione degli stakeholder e governance Processo e gestione del cambiamento Rischio, gestione dei problemi e delle dipendenze Budget, risorse e KPI Report e documentazione Miglioramento continuo ## Requisiti - Laurea triennale in economia aziendale, economia, ingegneria, gestione dei progetti o campo correlato. - Esperienza minima di 2-3 anni nella gestione di progetti, preferibilmente in ambienti di vendita al dettaglio, moda, catena di approvvigionamento, pianificazione o allocazione. - L'esperienza di lavoro su progetti di pianificazione, allocazione, previsione o pianificazione della merce è un forte vantaggio. - Solide capacità di gestione del progetto (ambito, tempistiche, risorse, rischi, budget). - Abile nella progettazione e nell'ottimizzazione dei framework di reporting di Power BI - Forte mentalità analitica con capacità di comprendere i driver di vendita, stock, margine e prestazioni. -
descriptionByLocale.en: The Project Manager supports the Retail teams by leading cross-functional projects aimed at improving planning, allocation, buying and merchandise planning processes, tools, and governance. The role ensures that strategic and operational initiatives are delivered on time, within scope, and aligned with business objectives, contributing to sales optimization, inventory efficiency, and profitability across the EMEA and NA regions. Acting as a key interface between Planning & Allocation, Finance, Buying, Retail Operations, IT, and Logistics, the Project Manager enables change, process standardization, and continuous improvement within a complex, fast-paced retail environment. Stakeholder Management & Governance Process & Change Management Risk, Issue & Dependency Management Budget, Resources & KPIs Reporting & Documentation Continuous Improvement ## Requirements - Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Economics, Engineering, Project Management, or related field. - Minimum 2-3 years of experience in project management, preferably in retail, fashion, supply chain, planning, or allocation environments. - Experience working on planning, allocation, forecasting, or merchandise planning projects is a strong advantage. - Solid project management skills (scope, timelines, resources, risks, budget). - Skilled in designing and optimizing Power BI reporting frameworks - Strong analytical mindset with ability to understand sales, stock, margin, and performance drivers. - Experience working with planning and allocation systems and reporting tools. - Proficiency in project management tools (e.g. MS Project, Jira, Asana, or similar). - Strong stakeholder management and communication skills across all organizational levels. - Ability to work in a fast-paced, dynamic retail environment. - Structured, proactive, and results-oriented approach. - High level of ownership, accountability, and problem-solving capability. - Team player with a collaborative and service-oriented mindset. - Fluent English (written and spoken). Additional European languages are a plus. ## Benefits - An International, fresh and dynamic working environment - Balance between work and personal life: Smart Working (Hybrid work model) and Time flexibility; - Physical & Mental Health programs, sustainable projects and workshop promoted by Guess Community - Arts, sports and social events outside the office, thanks to our Guess Fun activities! - Training & Development platform and paths - Discount on our products both online and in stores
descriptionByLocale.de: Der Projektmanager unterstützt die Retail-Teams durch die Leitung funktionsübergreifender Projekte zur Verbesserung von Planungs-, Allokations-, Einkaufs- und Warenplanungsprozessen, Tools und Governance. Die Rolle stellt sicher, dass strategische und operative Initiativen pünktlich, im Rahmen des Umfangs und im Einklang mit den Geschäftszielen umgesetzt werden und zu Umsatzoptimierung, Bestandseffizienz und Rentabilität in den Regionen EMEA und NA beitragen. Der Projektmanager fungiert als wichtige Schnittstelle zwischen Planung & Allokation, Finanzen, Einkauf, Einzelhandel, IT und Logistik und ermöglicht Veränderungen, Prozessstandardisierung und kontinuierliche Verbesserung in einem komplexen, schnelllebigen Einzelhandelsumfeld. Stakeholder Management & Governance Process & Change Management Risk, Issue & Dependency Management Budget, Resources & KPIs Reporting & Documentation Continuous Improvement ## Requirements - Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Economics, Engineering, Project Management, or related field. - Mindestens 2-3 Jahre Erfahrung im Projektmanagement, vorzugsweise in Einzelhandels-, Mode-, Lieferketten-, Planungs- oder Allokationsumgebungen. - Erfahrung in der Arbeit an Planungs-, Allokations-, Prognose- oder Warenplanungsprojekten ist ein starker Vorteil. - Solide Projektmanagementfähigkeiten (Umfang, Zeitpläne, Ressourcen, Risiken, Budget). - Geschickt im Entwerfen und Optimieren von Power BI-Reporting-Frameworks - Starke analytische Denkweise mit der Fähigkeit, Umsatz-, Lager-, Margen- und Leistungstreiber zu verstehen. -
descriptionByLocale.fr: Le chef de projet soutient les équipes de vente au détail en dirigeant des projets interfonctionnels visant à améliorer la planification, l'allocation, les processus de planification des achats et des marchandises, les outils et la gouvernance. Le rôle garantit que les initiatives stratégiques et opérationnelles sont livrées à temps, dans les limites de la portée et alignées sur les objectifs commerciaux, contribuant ainsi à l'optimisation des ventes, à l'efficacité des stocks et à la rentabilité dans les régions EMEA et NA. Agissant comme une interface clé entre la planification et l'allocation, les finances, les achats, les opérations de vente au détail, l'informatique et la logistique, le chef de projet permet le changement, la normalisation des processus et l'amélioration continue dans un environnement de vente au détail complexe et rapide. Gestion des parties prenantes et processus de gouvernance et gestion du changement Gestion des risques, des problèmes et des dépendances Budget, ressources et indicateurs clés de performance Rapports et documentation Amélioration continue ## Exigences - Baccalauréat en administration des affaires, économie, ingénierie, gestion de projet ou domaine connexe. - Minimum de 2 à 3 ans d'expérience en gestion de projet, de préférence dans des environnements de vente au détail, de mode, de chaîne d'approvisionnement, de planification ou d'allocation. - Expérience de travail sur des projets de planification, d'allocation, de prévision ou de planification de marchandises est un avantage important. - Solides compétences en gestion de projet (périmètre, délais, ressources, risques, budget). - Habileté à concevoir et à optimiser des cadres de reporting Power BI - Esprit analytique fort avec capacité à comprendre les facteurs de vente, de stock, de marge et de performance. -
